_instructions: Template for --startup-metadata. Copy per arm to runs/tp-ep-e2e/startup-<arm>.json and replace every REPLACE-ME with the value actually observed.

Every field below is required. compare enforces equality on all required fields except spark_tp, spark_ep, spark_artifact_roles and release_identity_full (the intended topology differences, recorded not matched).
expert_tp_manifests is a superset rule: every baseline family must appear in the candidate with an equal native_library_sha256; the candidate may add the family its role selects.

coordinator_argv and worker_argv are the argv actually applied, and their values are compared against the metadata (not just flag presence). worker_argv is one argv per physical rank and must cover 0..spark_tp*spark_ep-1 with --world == spark_tp*spark_ep.

requested_rtx_expert_layers is 'auto' or an explicit integer; resolved_rtx_expert_layers is the ACTUAL integer plan boundary and must match across arms, with spark_first_layer == min(resolved_rtx_expert_layers, 39). The literal 'auto' is never valid in resolved_rtx_expert_layers.

worker_capacity must be one of 1/16/80/256/1024/4096, must equal every worker --capacity value, and must be >= the launcher capacity for prefill_batch_tokens (<=80->80, <=256->256, <=1024->1024, else 4096).
concurrency, max_context_tokens and max_output_tokens are matched by exact value against --concurrency / --max-context-tokens / --max-output-tokens.
host_cache_bytes, http_queue_depth and http_queue_wait_ms are recorded for manual comparison; the validator does not gate them yet.
Source fields come from real artifacts, never from a synthetic 'passed': image labels plus scripts/write-v41-expert-tp-manifest.py output.

_provenance.source_artifact: coordinator and expert image RepoDigests plus label io.ds41rt.source-manifest.sha256 (a full manifest string is acceptable)
_provenance.source_snapshots: the daemon and native source trees those images were built from (source identity, not artifact-role-dependent manifest hashes; equal source means the same binaries plus the candidate's family superset)
_provenance.expert_tp_manifests: scripts/write-v41-expert-tp-manifest.py per-family output (native library sha256, tp_degree, intermediate); io.ds41rt.v41.spark_tp_roles names the built families
_provenance.requested_rtx_expert_layers: the requested value: 'auto' when --rtx-expert-layers is absent, else the explicit integer
_provenance.resolved_rtx_expert_layers: the ACTUAL integer boundary from the coordinator plan.json (or the single-RTX resolved value), never 'auto'
_provenance.spark_first_layer: min(resolved_rtx_expert_layers, 39), the value passed to the workers as --first-layer
_provenance.spark_device_budget_bytes: worker control --device-budget-bytes on expertd-native, not a coordinator flag
_provenance.power_caps_watts: host GPU power cap from nvidia-smi, not a CLI flag

source_artifact: REPLACE-ME coordinator+expert image digests and source-manifest sha256
